judgement.title: Your judgement
judgement.sub: Updated after every decision. It scores how you decide, not how much you earn.
judgement.empty: No decisions yet. Your first decision starts your judgement record.
judgement.skillsHint: A skill only counts once it has come up.

tips.research: Ask both questions before you invest.
tips.skepticism: Treat big stories and tips as claims to check.
tips.calm: Sell on bad data, not on a falling price.
tips.habits: Keep a cash cushion and avoid needless trades.

judgement.basedOn: Based on {{n}} of 5 skills so far

review.askedTwo: You asked both questions before investing, so you decided with real numbers.
review.askedOne: You asked one question. A second one shows more of the picture.
review.askedNone: You invested without asking anything. A headline is chosen to impress, so check the numbers first.
review.boughtDespiteWeak: You saw a Weak result on {{checks}} and invested anyway. That is a warning worth respecting.
review.readChecks: The checks you looked at were not Weak. You acted on what the numbers showed.
review.missedWeak: You did not look at {{checks}}, and the result was Weak. Asking would have shown you.
review.reasonData: Your reason was the data. That is the best reason to invest.
review.reasonFeeling: Your reason was “{{reason}}”. That is a feeling or something you heard, not evidence.
review.reasonFounder: A founder's confidence is a claim, not proof. Back it with numbers.
review.reasonPrice: A low price can mean a bargain, or a business that is shrinking. Check the numbers.
review.reasonGrowth: Growth is only good when cash and customers back it up.
review.concentrated: {{pct}}% of your invested money is now in {{sector}}. If that sector falls, so does most of your money.
review.diversified: Your money is spread across different sectors, so one bad sector hurts less.
review.bigBet: This purchase was {{pct}}% of your net worth. One surprise could decide your whole result.
review.noCushion: You left only {{r_cash}} in cash. Life's surprises cost money, so keep a cushion.
review.outcomeBuyUp: Since then the price is up {{pct}}%. One result is not proof; luck plays a part, so judge the decision by what you knew.
review.outcomeBuyDown: Since then the price is down {{pct}}%. One result is not proof; luck plays a part, so judge the decision by what you knew.
review.soldOnWarnings: You sold when the company showed warning signs ({{n}} Weak checks). Acting on data is the right reason to sell.
review.panicSold: You sold in a market fall with no warning signs from the company. A falling price is not a falling business.
review.soldTooSoon: You sold a healthy company quickly for a small gain. Selling early gives up the growth that time brings.
review.sellData: You sold for a reason based on data.
review.sellFeeling: Your reason was “{{reason}}”. Sell on bad data, not on a feeling.
review.sellNoSignal: Nothing in the numbers showed trouble when you sold. Make sure you had a reason.
review.forcedSale: You had to sell to pay a family emergency, at a loss or in a dip. A cash cushion would have let you wait.
review.forcedSaleOk: You sold to pay a family emergency. A cushion in cash avoids forced sales.
review.outcomeSellFell: Since you sold, the price fell {{pct}}%.
review.outcomeSellRose: Since you sold, the price rose {{pct}}%. You could not know that then: judge a sale by the data you had.
review.passedWeak: You passed on a company with {{n}} Weak checks. Staying out of a weak business is a good call.
review.passedStrong: This company looked healthy. Passing is safe, but money you do not invest loses about 1% a quarter.
review.passedMixed: This company showed mixed signs. Passing is reasonable.
review.passNoAsk: You passed without asking anything. Passing is safe, but asking would have taught you why.
review.passAsked: You asked before deciding, so your pass was informed.
review.heldWeak: You kept {{company}} even though {{n}} health checks are Weak. Selling on bad data is part of the skill.
review.heldStrong: Every health check is Strong. Holding a healthy business lets time do the work.
review.heldMixed: The checks are mixed ({{n}} Weak). Holding is reasonable, but keep watching them.
